title: Canva Brand Voice Cheat Sheet (Day 2 of 7)
tldr: Set the brand voice once in the Brand Kit; the Magic Write slash shortcut follows it.
Only owners, admins and brand designers can edit it on a team.

tools.name: Canva
tools.note: Brand voice is on Pro, Teams, Education, Nonprofits

steps.title: Open Brand Kits
steps.detail: Homepage side panel: Brand, then Brand Kits.

steps.title: Write the brief
steps.detail: Audience, formality, go to words, never words.

steps.title: Use Magic Write
steps.detail: Select text, press slash, choose Magic Write.
